meta.name: discovery-interview
meta.description: Deep interview process to transform vague ideas into detailed specs. Works for technical and non-technical users.

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法转化为详细需求规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将模糊想法转化为可执行的产品需求
copy.tagline_en: Transform vague ideas into detailed product specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn vague ideas into actionable product requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude会通过一系列深度提问，帮你把模糊的想法变成详细、可执行的产品规格说明书。它会识别你的知识盲区，主动做调研，最后生成一份完整的规格文档。
howto.when: 当你提出一个产品想法（比如“我想做一个分享食谱的App”），并且需要把它变成详细的开发规格时，Claude会启动这个深度访谈流程。

say.text: 我想做一个分享食谱的App，帮我梳理一下需求。
say.note: Claude会开始提问，了解你的目标用户、核心功能等。

say.text: 我需要一个后台API，但还不确定具体要什么。
say.note: Claude会针对后端服务类型进行深度访谈。

say.text: 帮我检查一下这个想法有没有遗漏的地方。
say.note: Claude会运行完整性检查，确保所有关键点都覆盖了。

howto.what_en: Claude conducts a deep interview process to transform vague ideas into detailed, implementable specifications. It detects knowledge gaps, researches when needed, and generates a complete spec document.
howto.when_en: When you have a product idea (e.g., 'I want to build a recipe-sharing app') and need to turn it into a detailed development specification, Claude initiates this deep interview process.

say_en.text: I want to build a recipe-sharing app. Help me define the requirements.
I need a backend API but I'm not sure about the specifics.
say_en.note: Claude will conduct a deep interview tailored to backend services.

say_en.text: Check if I'm missing anything in this idea.
say_en.note: Claude will run a completeness check to ensure all key points are covered.
